subject: Renewal: HealthSentry private footprint — privacy zones provisioning & term amendment
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@healthsentry.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning — adding privacy zones + on-prem cluster

Jonas,

Our renewal for the Private footprint is up in mid-August and we've got two requests from engineering and security:

- Provision two dedicated 'privacy zones' (isolated environments) for PHI workloads, each with a small on-prem cluster for local inference.
- Extend the term for those environments to 24 months with a capacity-topup schedule (Q3 + Q1 next year).

Can Redwood provide a scoping estimate and an amendment for the renewal that covers: cluster sizing, isolation controls (networking/KMS), and pricing for the term extension? We also need a timeline — procurement needs contract language by 7/10 to hit internal budget cycles.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call.

— Liam
Liam O'Connor
VP Ops, HealthSentry
liam@healthsentry.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@healthsentry.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — adding privacy zones + on-prem cluster

Liam — thanks for the clear ask. Quick response with next steps and what we need from HealthSentry to scope precisely: 

1) Proposal outline (we'll produce a draft amendment + SOW):
   - Two privacy zones (isolated VPCs) + one small on-prem GPU cluster per zone (2x A10-equivalent instances).
   - KV cache isolation, dedicated KMS key per zone, private peering, and strict egress controls.
   - Canary rollout for the first zone (30-day validation window) before provisioning the second.

2) Term & pricing:
   - We can offer a 24-month term for the zones with a graduated capacity top-up: 25% ramp at sign, 50% at month 6, remainder at month 12.
   - Preliminary uplift estimate: +35% ARR for the isolated environments (includes reserved capacity + private support SLA). We'll attach formal pricing in the amendment.

3) Timeline & deliverables:
   - Draft amendment, SOW, and infra diagram by 7/6.
   - Procurement-ready DocuSign + redline window by 7/10 (per your ask).

Items we need from you to finalize sizing: current qps distribution for PHI traffic, peak token/sec expectations, and whether the on-prem nodes require air-gap (no outbound). Also confirm the billing entity for the amendment.

Attaching a baseline infra diagram and a term-amendment draft (placeholder) for your procurement team to review. If it helps, I'll block 30m Thu or Fri for a joint call.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Attachments: SOW_HealthSentry_privacy-zones_v1.pdf; infra_zone_diagram.png; term-amendment-draft.docx
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal planning — HealthSentry privacy zones (need sizing + pricing)

Marissa / Vivek — forwarding HealthSentry's request (below). Key asks: two isolated privacy zones with one on-prem cluster each, 24m term, and procurement needs contract by 7/10.

My recommended approach:
- Offer a phased provisioning: Zone A (canary) then Zone B.
- Reserve 2 on-prem nodes per zone (A10-equivalent), with burst capacity routing to Hosted for non-sensitive workload.
- Price as a term-amendment: 24 months, 15% discount over monthly list for reserved capacity + 7.5% one-time isolation setup fee (networking/KMS/validation).

Questions for pricing: confirm whether we want to include professional services (setup/validation) as an add-on or bundle it. If we bundle, we can be more aggressive on the term discount.

If we sign on the 24m term, propose: reserved capacity commit schedule (25% sign / 50% month6 / final month12) and a 10% early-termination fee to protect capacity economics.

Marissa — can you draft the amended pricing lines and the SOW tasks (networking, KMS, on-prem install runbook)? Vivek — can you confirm the engineering lead time for the on-prem agent and whether we need an air-gapped package.

Thanks — we need a completed package by EOD 7/6 to keep procurement on schedule.

-- Jonas
From: procurement@healthsentry.com

Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@healthsentry.com>

2) HealthSentry requires SOC 2 Type II evidence and the attestation letter for our security review. If there are any additional artifacts (auditor name, last audit date, control scope) include those.

We're attaching our standard procurement checklist (not included here). For timing: if Redwood can send the doc by 7/10, we expect sign-off no later than 7/22 depending on internal review.
